payload.title: anchor_candidate_groups returns a held mixed-tree true_positive pair outside the demand bound, and stability_reask.stability_candidates passes that selector's output straight to the re-ask budget, so a pair that no arbiter will ever be minted for can take stability budget ahead of unanimous pairs while the lane's docstring still says only false_positive pairs come back without demand.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1183-1188 (the selector's docstring: a held group is returned and spends no demand)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1213-1225 (a true_positive pair with a hold skips the new_pairs check and is appended)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/stability_reask.py:144-152 (stability_candidates docstring: without demand only false-positive pairs are returned)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/stability_reask.py:155-165 (every returned group becomes a stability candidate with its seats)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/stability_reask.py:224-236 (the budget counts minted re-asks, not candidates, so earlier candidates spend it first)
payload.rule_violated: The stability lane's own contract (stability_reask.py:147-152): true_positive pairs are examined only up to the demand it passes; a candidate the arbiter arms refuse as held is not a pair the lane is meant to spend a re-ask on.
payload.notes: A true_positive pair whose seats judged different trees is held, so it can never reach an arbiter or an anchor, yet with demand 0 (or after the demand is used up) it is still returned to the stability lane, which re-mints both of its seats under stability groups and decrements the budget. In group-key order such pairs come ahead of later unanimous pairs, so stability_budget is spent on pairs that cannot anchor and the docstring that documents the selector's behaviour is false. Close condition: Exclude pairs whose group carries a hold from stability_candidates (or give anchor_candidate_groups an include_held argument only the dispatcher sets), correct the docstring, and pin with a test that stability_candidates(demand=0) over a held true_positive pair returns no true_positive pair. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
